definitions.prec_resistor: rpm AND (poly overlapping poly.rs) AND psdm
definitions.de_pFet_drain: ((isolated tap) AND areaid.en) not overlapping nwell
definitions.deFET_gate: (poly AND areaid.en) not overlapping pwm ; For CAD flows that do not have pwm layer, it is (poly AND areaid.en)
definitions.VHVSourceDrain: (Diff AND tap) And vhvi NOT poly NOT diff:rs

dnwell.reason: Every selected deep-well subject is the raw deep well or a subset of it. Empty deep well also has no separate-net spacing or straddle interactions.

nwell_holes.reason: The required enclosed target is the hole of the merged drawn nwell. It is measured directly; empty dnwell alone is insufficient.

lvtn.reason: The selected subjects contain drawn LVTN or its holes; the entire raw layer is empty. The separate gate-enclosure obligation lvtn.4b is not included.

hvtr.reason: Width, spacing and no-overlap require HVTR geometry. The separate PFET-enclosure obligation hvtr.3 is not included.

hvi.reason: Width, spacing and no-overlap use HVI or a subset; HVI is empty. This does not establish correct voltage identification.

rdl.reason: All RDL, PAD and CCU1M mask shapes are empty. PAD is explicitly required absent for pad-enclosure; RDL absence alone cannot discharge that target.

rpm.reason: Raw RPM is empty. C3 defines prec_resistor through intersection with RPM, so the resistor target is also empty. No non-empty resistor or terminal geometry is qualified.

tunm.reason: The selected TUNM width/spacing/area/containment/straddle subjects require TUNM. The tunm.3 gate-extension record is deliberately excluded pending target interpretation.

hvntm.reason: Both HVNTM and HVI are empty. HVI emptiness discharges the explicitly HVI-selected diffusion and ESD-tap enclosure targets; HVNTM emptiness alone would not.

vhvi.reason: C3 VHVGate, VHVPoly and VHVSourceDrain require VHVI. With no such geometry there is no selected root for the listed connectivity propagation. Independent voltage/tagging intent remains unproved.

extended_drain.reason: C3 drain-extended gates, sources and drains require areaid.en; its absence discharges only the explicitly selected subjects. The ambiguous angle records and extd.3 catalog target are excluded.

ncm.reason: The selected width/spacing/area subjects are NCM or its holes. The separate P+ diffusion enclosure obligations ncm.3 and ncm.4 are not included.
